chunks.heading: The Architecture of Being
chunks.notes: Opens with the central claim about duality/presence and immediately re-narrates it through concrete images (cake, desert, cold tap water) rather than leaving it implicit, and names "threshold" and hunger/desire directly.

chunks.heading: The Architecture of Being
chunks.notes: Redefines greatness via illustrative images (grandmother's hands kneading dough, halls of children/elders) then explains the point in abstract terms, and dwells on isolation/vanity and fading family lineage.

chunks.heading: The Architecture of Being
chunks.notes: Grounds the "sovereignty over becoming" claim in a specific illustrative memory (the grandfather's death) and explicitly names "architect"/architecture in its closing image, with an awareness-acceptance-action sequence re-explaining the point.

chunks.heading: The Architecture of Being
chunks.notes: Closes the essay's arc on identity/becoming, using "replica"/"echo"/"original" imagery (mirror/doppelganger territory) and dwelling on people who die never feeling at home in their own skin.
